mistake_reason: Information Withholding (FM-2.4): At step 5, WebSurfer accessed the Wikipedia section that explicitly lists both Cuba (1) and Panama (1) as one-athlete delegations at the 1928 Summer Olympics. However, WebSurfer reported only that the minimum was 1 and selectively mentioned Panama while omitting Cuba. This withheld critical information that directly impacted the tie-breaking requirement (alphabetically, Cuba precedes Panama). Subsequent prompts to enumerate all one-athlete NOCs (step 7) and to cross-check on Olympedia (step 13) continued this omission, causing the team to incorrectly finalize PAN instead of the correct CUB.
